acceptance.humanAnswer: Accept these evaluation targets and protocol
acceptance.limits: Acceptance of experimental evaluation policy, not measured qualification, candidate promotion, authenticated custody, weaker LQP004 safety or release publication.

protocol.platform: macOS arm64 Go1.27.1 gopls0.23.0 exact digests recorded
limits: single canonical root; multiple roots must explicitly refuse with no partial admission
new standard-method advertisement only after exact method qualification; other OS/versions/languages remain unqualified

corpus.public: exact-symbol/range frozen public calibration plus real-workspace failure cases
corpus.heldout: 20 independently selected tasks across at least3 complete pinned Go repositories; one go.work/multiple-module layout
corpus.custody: Independent evaluator freezes immutable repository/task/gold manifest outside builder workspace before candidate execution; builder sees manifest digest and task IDs, never gold; no candidate repair and re-evaluation on same protected set
corpus.scoring: actual task decisions and source/target identities; no path-only score used as task success

qualityFloors.combinedSemanticRecall: not below upstream on matched applicable tasks
qualityFloors.combinedTaskSuccess: not below best applicable baseline and at least one declared governance+semantic task improved; paired numerators/denominators and abstentions retained

measurementProtocol.cache: Fixed prepared offline dependencies/Go build cache from immutable inputs; fresh private gopls/Core runtime caches for each cold arm; matched declared warm-up then persistent warm sessions. This qualifies prepared workspace, not empty-machine install performance.
measurementProtocol.metrics: exact correctness/coverage/freshness and task success; all samples including failures; nearest-rank p50/p95; wall/CPU and bounded owned-group RSS sampling with explicit peak limitations; packet/query counts
clientCases: rapid edits and stale replies without repeat-until-pass
actual editor INT/TERM and descendant retirement
measurementProtocol.limits: RSS sampling granularity and any unobserved counters remain explicit; unmeasured ceilings prevent promotion, no simulated result substitutes
measurementProtocol.allocation: 20cold operations and100warm operations per consumer/method/arm on each declared complete repository; no pooling CLI/MCP/editor mechanisms; deterministic arm rotation upstream/core/combined by repetition index, fixed task-order seed in manifest
measurementProtocol.warmup: 5 unscored but retained requests per exact consumer/method/root; fixed before measured100; CLI still launches one process per operation with warm declared caches, never invented daemon
measurementProtocol.timing: cold from owned process launch through initialize/first complete reply and separately total command/session lifecycle; warm from actual client request send to complete typed reply; timeout/failure charged configured deadline in latency samples and recorded as failure
measurementProtocol.cpu: CPU seconds of owned server/worker/provider process set per operation; editor process attribution measured separately (not silently omitted); startup separated from warm request; unavailable accounting prevents corresponding resourcefloor pass
measurementProtocol.rss: Observed simultaneous sum RSS of positively witnessed owned editor/server/worker/provider descendants sampled every100ms, start/end inventory retained; missing/ambiguous census preventspass. Sample maximum is only a lower bound on true peak, explicitly not hard physical-memory containment
measurementProtocol.bytes: Total serialized agent JSON envelope <=256KiB, externalrecord <=64KiB; complete editor LSPbody <=1MiB; query64/relations32 are perrequest ceilings and truncation/stopping reasons retained
measurementProtocol.custody: Independent evaluator procedure only on shared host, no authenticated filesystem access boundary claimed; evaluator freezes3repo commits/dependency/cache manifests,20unique tasks and complete gold SHA before candidate execution. Builder receives IDs/digests only; full scored report revealed after immutable candidate run; no same-set repair/retest. Existing sealed holdouts never opened or reused.

baselineEvidence.observations: Corrected public paths6/6 each arm, descriptive combined8-13s. One configured pilot8.22wall/24.54CPU seconds, Darwin time-reported maxRSS1.39GB; not matched cold/warm or aggregate peak proof. Floors above are product policy proposals, not inferred qualification.
baselineEvidence.safetyGap: Independent review /tmp/lsp-qualification-freeze-plan-rereview.md identified current definition manual-restart/static-root limits cannot satisfy LQP004. Preserve this blocker and implement actual engine invalidation; no scope-only promotion.

protocol.promotion: No promotion or parent nativecompletion until every accepted floor, independent review, governing full gate and actual native dependencies/complete write pass. Any failure retains experimental/fallback status and original failed results.
protocol.wireBaseline: LSP3.17 subset; stdio JSON-RPC2.0; UTF8 Neovim, UTF16 VSCode; negotiate and record actual capabilities, no version inheritance

methodMatrix.facts: immutable Git Core packet, external committed Go definition/reference path evidence only
methodMatrix.unsupported: overlay/editor state and writes; missing provider/deps remain explicit unavailable; all query failure cannot be semantic success

methodMatrix.entry: task-review versus opt-in task-review-lsp / corvint.context with lsp:gopls
methodMatrix.facts: same admitted committed snapshot and intact Core packet as CLI; no overlay replaces committed proof

methodMatrix.entry: direct textDocument/definition after explicit experimental initialize; standard definitionProvider remains absent until exact-method gate and accepted advertisement
methodMatrix.facts: synchronized OPEN full-text source and target overlays only; navigation location carries no committed authority
methodMatrix.unsupported: Closed/disk/external targets remain unavailable; invalid incremental sync terminates; multiple/mismatched roots refuse; save/rename are not editing features, but engine MUST still invalidate/withhold affected stale results under LQP004 before definition can be promoted

methodMatrix.facts: intact Git-bound Core separately from URI/version/SHA/session/capture nonGit overlay observation
methodMatrix.unsupported: no arbitrary tool selector, tests, source edits or upstream method dispatch

caseExpectations.Unicode/fulltext/openoverlay: correct exact source/target coordinates, captures and unchanged disk unless external test action
caseExpectations.cancel/rapid/close/reopen: old pending work cancelled/joined; no stale reply promotion; healthy newest full replacement/reopened capture retry; all predeclared scheduling misses retain denominator
caseExpectations.save/rename: Engine must reject/mark stale after actual save and rename transitions under LQP004. No requested edit/refactor operation is introduced. Close/reopen controls are distinct; manual restart cannot substitute for engine guarantee.
caseExpectations.branch/rootDrift: Both promoted definition and context methods must reject or explicitly mark stale when actual branch/root drift affects results. Context must give fixed REPOSITORY_CHANGED/root error. Manual operator restart is containment only and cannot pass definition drift qualification.
caseExpectations.multipleRoot/externalURI: explicit rejection/unavailability, never partial root admission
caseExpectations.missingProviderOrDependencies: visible unavailable/refusal; no install/download; no invented semantic facts
caseExpectations.hostile/crash/EOF/INT/TERM: fixed redacted error or terminal closure as predeclared; all owned descendants retired; ordinary cancellation preserves healthy session

scoringRules.units: Gold is typed per consumer: direct gopls/editor definition uses exact source and target identifiers/ranges with committed source blobs or nonGit overlay session/capture/digest as appropriate; agent external semantics uses only its emitted path-relation type, source query point/rule, immutable endpoint paths/blobs/revision/provenance, never invents an unreturned target range; Core governance uses exact requirement/authority/test identities. Each task freezes finite required units and complete admissible units before execution.
scoringRules.microPrecision: TP/(TP+FP) pooled per consumer and method across supported applicable tasks; when no claim is emitted precision is N/A and recall/task floors still apply; no optimistic zero denominator
scoringRules.microRecall: TP/(TP+FN) against all frozen required supported facts; duplicate claims deduplicated by exact identity; abstention/noanswer/timeout/malformed/provider failure contributes all missed facts to FN and binary task failure
scoringRules.taskSuccess: binary joint success only when every required semantic fact and governance decision is correct with no invalid/unsafe claim; for one-domain tasks only the frozen required domain applies Gold task wording may ask for only the information that its consumer can actually emit; exact target-symbol tasks cannot pass on agent path-only facts. An agent method gap is failure/unsupported, never filled by evaluator inference.
scoringRules.baselineApplicability: Frozen per task before execution. Unsupported domains do not become successful answers; joint tasks are scored for each arm, with missing required domain a failure. Report method metrics independently for applicable domains
scoringRules.aggregation: All20 heldout tasks retain paired binary outcome for all3arms; combined success count >=max(upstreamSuccessCount,CoreSuccessCount), at least1 joint task that both baselines fail is solved by combined; semantic recall >=upstream and governance accuracy >=Core over fixed applicable subsets
scoringRules.unsupportedCases: separate protocol safety denominator with100% expected exact refusal/termination, never counted as semantic recovered facts or task benefit
scoringRules.exclusions: None after freeze; all attempted tasks/schedules and crashes remain; no timing-success-only samples or selective reruns
scoringRules.uncertainty: Report TP/FP/FN, counts, per-task outputs and binomial intervals; these floors are sample admission policy, not universal population reliability

protocol.profileBoundary: Numbers and rubric are accepted only as experimental evaluation targets. Each promoted method must independently pass the full LQP004 drift-engine guarantee and every other floor. Any method relying only on manual restart remains UNQUALIFIED; no owning safety contract is weakened. Current missing engine/client cases require separate bounded implementation/qualification before any parent closure.

normalization: Only proposal status relabeled to actual accepted experimental status; targets and protocol unchanged.
